SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeEdgeForThicknessUp
	distance: 5
	direction: Qt.point(0, -1) 
	conditionName:  eraseOr
	condition: (toolbar.selectedTool === toolbar.eraserMenus)
	releaseRequired: false
	areas: Values.accessibilityRightHanded ? Qt.rect(0,0, touchArea.edgeSize,toolbar.height): Qt.rect(touchArea.width,0, -touchArea.edgeSize,toolbar.height)
	fingers:1
	action:{if(documentViewTools.isWritingTool(documentViewTools.activePen.tool) && documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 11 && documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 8){
							documentViewTools.activePen.thickness =   documentViewTools.activePen.thickness+0.5 }}
}
END SLOT
SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeEdgeForThicknessDown
	distance: 	5
	direction:Qt.point(0, 1)
	releaseRequired: false
	conditionName:  eraseOr
	condition: (toolbar.selectedTool === toolbar.eraserMenus)
	areas: Values.accessibilityRightHanded ? Qt.rect(0,0, touchArea.edgeSize,toolbar.height): Qt.rect(touchArea.width,0, -touchArea.edgeSize,toolbar.height)
	fingers:1
	action:{
	if(documentViewTools.isWritingTool(documentViewTools.activePen.tool) && documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 11 && documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 8){
							documentViewTools.activePen.thickness =   documentViewTools.activePen.thickness-0.5 }   } 
}
END SLOT
